cold_open: Fadi started the best possible lineup, scored 100.19, third-best in the league, and lost by 19.18. Kevin O'Boyle's 119.37 would have beaten all eleven teams. Shawn scored 74.6, tenth-best, and won.

notes.Fadi|Kevin O'Boyle: The unluckiest loss: Fadi's lineup was perfect and beat its projection by 26.8. O'Boyle beat projection by 27.57, and the 119.37 is the seventh-best Week 4 score in league history. O'Boyle leads 20–8.
notes.Dominic|Shawn: The luckiest win: Shawn's 74.6 was tenth-best, but Dominic's 59.45 was the week's low. It snaps Dominic's five-game run, Shawn's first win in the series since Week 1 of 2021. Dominic leads 13–12.
notes.Eric|Steve Swanson: The week's biggest blowout, by 25.99, and it didn't have to happen: Steve's best lineup scored 91.74. Romeo Doubs's 17.9 sat behind D'Andre Swift's 2.7. Eric has won four straight and leads 4–2.
notes.Brian Clark|Jeff: A week after Jalen Hurts started over Brock Purdy's 31.64, Hurts scored 14.76 on Clark's bench. Clark won with 101.51, second-best in the league, and takes an 8–7 series lead.
notes.Douglas|Thomas: Tom started the tight end and the kicker of the week, Sam LaPorta and Will Reichard, and lost. Doug won with Brian Robinson's 21.85 benched behind Jacory Croskey-Merritt's 3.5. Doug leads 10–5.
notes.Evan|Kevin Swanson: The week's narrowest win, by 8.11. Swanson's best possible lineup scored 83.15, four hundredths more than Evan's 83.11. Tetairoa McMillan's 28.6, the receiver of the week, carried Evan. Series even, 16–16.

kicker: Last week Drake Maye was the dud of the week, −1.12 on a 15.07 projection. This week, still in Eric's lineup, he was the quarterback of the week: 24.08.
